Q. 1 سَرْبَخْتُ فِى المَشْىِ , inf. n. سَرْبَخَةٌ, I walked, or marched, an hour, or a while: (JK:) [or in the middle of the day: and gently, or in a leisurely manner: for] ―
-b2- سَرْبَخَةٌ signifies The walking, or marching, in the middle of the day. (K.) And The walking, or marching, gently, or in a leisurely manner. (JK, K.) ―
-b3- And The being light, or agile, or active; light in any work or action, or unsteady or lightwitted, or so on an occasion of anger, or hasty, with foolishness or ignorance; syn. خِفَّةٌ and نَزَقٌ. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
